items.name: Longsword
items.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by skirmishers and cavalry.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description:
The bloody blade mercenary designates a single creature as their prey and focuses their attacks against that creature. The mercenary must be able to see or hear the prey, or must be tracking the prey during exploration.

The mercenary gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seeks their prey and a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks when they Tracks their prey. The mercenary also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within their second range increment against the prey they are hunting.

The mercenary can have only one creature designated as their prey at a time. If they use Hunt Prey against a creature when they already have a creature designated, the prior creature loses the designation and the new prey gains the designation. This designation lasts until their next daily preparations.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunted Shot
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirement The bloody blade mercenary is wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0

The bloody blade mercenary takes two quick shots against the one they hunt. They make two Strikes against their prey with the required weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply the mercenary's multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally.

offensiveAbilities.name: Precision
offensiveAbilities.description: The first time the mercenary hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal 1d8 additional precision damage.
